Screenshots, recording and screen tools

Screenshots, annotation, text recognition, color picker and screen recording

KeysWhat it does
Print ScreenScreenshot of the whole screen
Shift+Print Screen or Super+Shift+SScreenshot of an area: drag a rectangle
Super+Shift+TCopy the text in an area (OCR)
Super+Shift+CColor picker: click any pixel, its hex code is copied
Super+Shift+PPin an area of the screen: draw a rectangle, it stays floating on top
Super+Alt+RStart or stop recording the screen
Super+Alt+Shift+RRecord an area: draw a rectangle

Screenshots are saved to ~/Pictures/Screenshots and copied to the clipboard. The notification offers:

  • Pin to Screen: the screenshot floats above every window (see below);
  • Annotate: arrows, text, highlighter, blur and crop (swappy);
  • Copy Text: recognizes the text in it;
  • Ask Aurora: explains what's on screen (with Aurora AI on).

Text recognition works offline with Tesseract, in English plus your language (18 scripts).

#Pinned screenshots

A pinned screenshot stays above every window and on every workspace, like a sticky note of the screen: keep a reference, a code sample or a chart in view while you work in another app. Pin with Pin to Screen on a screenshot's notification or with Super+Shift+P (draw the area).

  • Drag it anywhere; the mouse wheel makes it bigger or smaller.
  • Ctrl+C copies the picture; right-click for Copy, Save As…, Open and Unpin.
  • Double-click, Esc or × unpins it.

#Recording the screen

Control Center → Screen Recording starts; a red dot appears in the top bar; the same tile stops. The tile's arrow offers Record the whole screen, Record an area… (draw a rectangle) and Record the computer's sound (on or off, remembered). Super+Alt+R starts and stops from the keyboard, Super+Alt+Shift+R records an area. Recordings are MP4 files in ~/Videos/Screencasts. For more control (sound, webcam, streaming) install OBS Studio from App Center.
